org.apache.beam.sdk.io.solace.write

Class UnboundedSolaceWriter

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.apache.beam.sdk.transforms.DoFn<KV<java.lang.Integer,Solace.Record>,Solace.PublishResult>
      • org.apache.beam.sdk.io.solace.write.UnboundedSolaceWriter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, HasDisplayData
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    UnboundedBatchedSolaceWriter, UnboundedStreamingSolaceWriter

    @Internal
public abstract class UnboundedSolaceWriter
extends DoFn<KV<java.lang.Integer,Solace.Record>,Solace.PublishResult>
    This DoFn encapsulates common code used both for the UnboundedBatchedSolaceWriter and UnboundedStreamingSolaceWriter.
